description.value: Blue Chip Cafe is a student-union-owned cafe on the main floor of the AMS Nest at UBC Vancouver, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the campus. It serves Spirit Bear coffee, specialty barista drinks, baked goods, sandwiches, and a range of vegan and gluten-free options. Catering and online pickup ordering are also available.

address.value: 6133 University Blvd, UBC Campus, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 56m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 93m; stands (14 spaces) at 99m. Total: 44 spaces.
